faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: We blend creativity, technology, and strategy to deliver powerful solutions that elevate your brand in the digital world.
faq.still_questions_body: Our team is here to help. Let's chat about your project.

items.question: Where do candidates come from?
items.answer: Lokerly aggregates data from public professional networks, your existing database, and applicant submissions.

items.question: What technologies do you work with?
items.answer: We work with the latest web and mobile technologies including React, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, and many more.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Project timelines vary depending on scope and complexity. A typical MVP takes 6-12 weeks, while a full-scale product can take 3-6 months.

items.question: Do you offer post-launch support?
items.answer: Yes! We offer comprehensive post-launch support and maintenance packages to ensure your product stays healthy and up-to-date.

items.question: What is your pricing model?
items.answer: We offer both fixed-price and time-and-materials pricing models depending on your project needs. Contact us for a custom quote.

items.question: Can you work with our existing team?
items.answer: Absolutely. We frequently embed our specialists within client teams to augment capacity and accelerate delivery.
